verdict.rationale: Context.dev is a web scraping and extraction API, so getting past anti-bot walls is a fair axis, but the evidence documents no CAPTCHA solving, target-site login or session handling, or form filling. Browser actions (click, wait, scroll) and overlay handling for screenshots are adjacent controls, not wall bypass. The auth flow covers agents authenticating to Context.dev's own API, not to target sites.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent automatically get past a CAPTCHA, login, or form wall without my manual intervention
